children: Boohoo looks set to deliver growth following a period of restructuring and deleveraging, analysts at RBC Capital Markets say. "The competitive advantages of the Debenhams marketplace are underappreciated," Richard Chamberlain and Manjari Dhar write in a note. The company has potential to deliver strong pretax profit growth and cash generation in the coming years, they add. "We think the shares have become more investable," the analysts say. RBC upgrades the stock to outperform from underperform. Shares closed at 25.5 pence on Friday. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
